# Aircraft refit

Used in [Air Game — flight and maintenance](/rules/air/30-flight-and-maintenance).

## By squadron

| Die | Percent refitted |
|---|---|
| 1 | 100 |
| 2 | 80 |
| 3 | 70 |
| 4 | 60 |
| 5 | 50 |
| 6–7 | 40 |
| 8–9 | 33 |

## By squadron modifiers

| When | Add |
|---|---|
| <span class="wrap">aircraft not of the working sgsus squadron</span> | 1 |
| german | 1 |
| italian | 2 |

## By plane

- **CW:** 2–8
- **German:** 2–7
- **Italian:** 2–6
- **Other squadron add:** 2

## Notes

- Aircraft Refit Table, printed as 38.37 on chart page 10 (jp2 104); the rules call it 38.38. Read twice, from the archive.org scan and the community chart PDFs (Shared Charts.pdf p. 10): 0 of 17 cells differ.
- by_squadron: one die per squadron (38.34), modified per 38.35, read the percentage of its aircraft refitted; fractions of aircraft round up. Rows run to 9 because the additions can take a roll past 6.
- by_plane: the optional method of 38.39, two dice per aircraft; refitted if the roll is within the range for its nation. +2 if the aircraft is not the working SGSU's own squadron's.
- The chart words the national additions by the SGSU doing the work (German SGSU +1, Italian SGSU +2), where 38.35 words them by the aircraft refitted; R-112 follows 38.35 (german/italian mean the aircraft's nation).
